trigger_condition: Hook cwd is a drive root such as C:\ (single path segment)
potential_consequence: extractRepository returns 'C:' not 'unknown'; breaks identifier contract and the test's no-drive-prefix assertion

trigger_condition: Hook cwd is a home directory like /Users/alice or C:\Users\alice
potential_consequence: Identifier 'Users/alice' leaks OS username into analytics as the repository

trigger_condition: ctx.cwd undefined or non-string at runtime (hook input lacks cwd)
potential_consequence: extractRepository throws on undefined; hook event build fails and events are dropped

trigger_condition: Existing analytics consumers or spool records expect cwd as absolute path (schema_version still 2)
guard_snippet: schema_version: 3 or add separate repository field alongside cwd
potential_consequence: Downstream consumers see changed cwd semantics under the same schema version; mixed data
